cards.ex: We stand in solidarity with those protesting for democracy.
cards.exUz: Biz demokratiya uchun norozilik bildirayotganlar bilan birdammiz.

cards.ex: Citizens must be able to freely exercise their rights without fear.
cards.exUz: Fuqarolar o'z huquqlarini qo'rqmasdan erkin amalga oshira olishlari kerak.
cards.uzDef: O'z huquqlaridan foydalanish, ularni ro'yobga chiqarish.

cards.ex: The excessive red tape is hindering the delivery of aid.
cards.exUz: Ortiqcha byurokratiya yordam yetkazib berishga to'sqinlik qilmoqda.

cards.ex: Land ownership remains a major bone of contention in the region.
cards.exUz: Yer egaligi mintaqada asosiy tortishuv sababi bo'lib qolmoqda.

cards.ex: It's the government's duty to uphold the law and maintain order.
cards.exUz: Hukumatning vazifasi - qonunni himoya qilish va tartibni saqlash.
cards.uzDef: Qonunni saqlash, unga rioya qilishni ta'minlash.

cards.ex: Everyone is entitled to due process under the law.
cards.exUz: Har bir kishi qonun bo'yicha tegishli tartibga haqli.

cards.ex: We need policies that create a level playing field for all businesses.
cards.exUz: Bizga barcha bizneslar uchun teng sharoit yaratadigan siyosatlar kerak.

cards.ex: The government is trying to quell the growing social unrest.
cards.exUz: Hukumat o'sib borayotgan ijtimoiy notinchlikni bostirishga harakat qilmoqda.

cards.ex: The report highlights the problem of entrenched inequality in the education system.
cards.exUz: Hisobot ta'lim tizimidagi mustahkam tengsizlik muammosini yoritadi.
cards.uzDef: Chuqur ildiz otgan, o'zgarishi qiyin bo'lgan tengsizlik.

cards.ex: Activists are calling for reform of the prison system.
cards.exUz: Faollar qamoqxona tizimini isloh qilishga chaqirmoqda.

cards.ex: The school has a zero tolerance policy towards bullying.
cards.exUz: Maktabda bezorilikka nisbatan nol tolerantlik siyosati mavjud.

cards.ex: The new law could disenfranchise thousands of voters.
cards.exUz: Yangi qonun minglab saylovchilarni huquqdan mahrum qilishi mumkin.

cards.ex: The poor often bear the brunt of economic crises.
cards.exUz: Kambag'allar ko'pincha iqtisodiy inqirozlarning og'ir yukini ko'taradilar.
cards.uzDef: Eng katta qiyinchilik yoki zarar ko'rmoq.

cards.ex: There's still a social stigma attached to mental illness.
cards.exUz: Hali ham ruhiy kasallikka ijtimoiy tamg'a yopishtirilgan.

cards.ex: His actions fly in the face of everything he preached.
cards.exUz: Uning harakatlari u targ'ib qilgan hamma narsaga zid.

cards.ex: Many families are living on the breadline due to job losses.
cards.exUz: Ko'p oilalar ishdan ayrilgani sababli qashshoqlik chegarasida yashamoqda.
cards.uzDef: O'ta kambag'al ahvolda, eng zarur narsalarga ham puli yetmaydigan.

cards.ex: The program aims to support underrepresented groups in STEM fields.
cards.exUz: Dastur STEM sohalarida kam vakillik qilgan guruhlarni qo'llab-quvvatlashga qaratilgan.
cards.uzDef: Jamiyatda yetarli darajada ovozi eshitilmaydigan guruhlar.

cards.ex: The website was taken down for promoting hate speech.
cards.exUz: Veb-sayt nafrat nutqini targ'ib qilgani uchun o'chirib tashlandi.
cards.uzDef: Biror guruhga nisbatan nafrat uyg'otadigan gaplar.

cards.ex: The government wanted to create a level playing field so all businesses could compete fairly.
cards.exUz: Hukumat barcha bizneslar adolatli raqobatlasha olishlari uchun teng sharoit yaratmoqchi edi.

cards.ex: There's a clear double standard in how men and women are treated.
cards.exUz: Erkaklar va ayollarga qanday munosabatda bo'lishda aniq qo'sh standart mavjud.
cards.uzDef: Bir xil vaziyatlarga nisbatan har xil qoidalar qo'llash.

cards.ex: The social safety net is there to help people in times of crisis.
cards.exUz: Ijtimoiy himoya tarmog'i inqiroz paytlarida odamlarga yordam berish uchun mo'ljallangan.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin ahvoldagi odamlarga yordam beradigan dasturlar.

cards.ex: We need to focus on providing support to marginalized communities.
cards.exUz: Biz chekka hududlarga yordam ko'rsatishga e'tibor qaratishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Jamiyatda asosiy oqimdan chetda qolgan jamoalar.

cards.ex: Rampant corruption is undermining the country's development.
cards.exUz: Keng tarqalgan korrupsiya mamlakat rivojlanishiga putur yetkazmoqda.

cards.ex: Women still face a glass ceiling in many corporations.
cards.exUz: Ayollar hali ham ko'plab korporatsiyalarda shisha shiftga duch kelishmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Yuqori lavozimlarga ko'tarilishga to'sqinlik qiladigan yashirin cheklov.

cards.ex: The authorities can't continue to turn a blind eye to the problem.
cards.exUz: Hokimiyatlar muammoga e'tibor bermaslikni davom ettira olmaydi.

cards.ex: The lack of accountability is a major problem in the government.
cards.exUz: Javobgarlikning yo'qligi hukumatda asosiy muammo hisoblanadi.
cards.uzDef: O'z harakatlari uchun javob berishning yo'qligi.

cards.ex: He will have to bear the consequences of his actions.
cards.exUz: U o'z harakatlarining oqibatlarini ko'tarishi kerak bo'ladi.

cards.ex: Many families are in dire straits due to the economic downturn.
cards.exUz: Ko'p oilalar iqtisodiy pasayish tufayli og'ir ahvolda qolmoqda.

cards.ex: Freedom of expression is a fundamental human right.
cards.exUz: Fikr erkinligi - insonning asosiy huquqi.

cards.ex: The new law threatens our civil liberties.
cards.exUz: Yangi qonun bizning fuqarolik erkinliklarimizga tahdid solmoqda.
